messages:
jamie-partners: Heads-up 1: wee28099re consolidating a final launch gate playbook for the marketplace listing + HW partner rollout + SI handoff. Goal: single doc with asset drop timeline, approvals, and rollback triggers. Who can take owner?

lee-gTM: I can own the playbook doc and timeline. Planning dry-run on Jun 10, launch Jun 17. Need to confirm localized landing pages (en, fr, de) and pricing SKU mapping.

carla-comm: Ie28099ll own comms assets (blog, press memo, social). Requesting partner quote copy + any partner customer case blurbs by Jun 3.

yuki-hw: HW partner update: certification images + quickstart guide will be ready Jun 1. We need a marketplace SKU that maps to our device bundle vs SW-only SKU. Also asking for a sample listing screenshot for marketplace UI.

raj-si: SI acceptance criteria: provisioning script, pre-populated dataset, end-to-end test script, and a runbook for customer handover. Wee28099ll validate on staging and sign off.

marta-legal: Legal checklist: partner trademark approvals, quote approvals, and export control check for hardware SKU. Quote approvals require written consent from partner PR contact. Expect 48h turnaround if received by Jun 5.

tom-ops: Ops note: staging clusters available Jun 4. If SI needs extended parallel runs, request quota now. Also: wire up telemetry namespace for partner so we can validate metrics ingestion.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Preflight policy scan complete. No high-severity issues.

jamie-partners: Good. Lee e28094 for SKUs, can you propose mapping table? Carla e28094 can you draft the embargo note and recipient list? Yuki e28094 will you share the quickstart link?

lee-gTM: Will post SKU mapping by May 28. Proposed fields: sku_id | product_variant | billing_unit | region_availability | notes.

carla-comm: Draft embargo: Jun 16 07:00 PT embargo lift Jun 17 10:00 PT public. Sending to list: select cloud beat reporters + ecosystem outlets. Will share recipients for review.

yuki-hw: Quickstart link: https://partners.example/quickstart-yuki. Device photo assets in that repo. Note: two images need background cleanup.

raj-si: Sample runbook snippet (high level):
```
1) Create tenant with partner flag
2) Install partner adapter v1.2
3) Load sample dataset (customers.csv)
4) Run smoke test: 20 inference calls across 5 models
5) Verify telemetry: request_count, avg_latency, error_rate
6) Trigger model rollback and validate fallback
```

marta-legal: Please attach partner-signed quote PDF when you post quotes. I will check trademark usage and reply with approved copy or edits.

tom-ops: Action: provisioning request acknowledged. ETA: full staging and telemetry schema ready Jun 4 17:00 UTC. If you need earlier, send priority tag.

jamie-partners: Risks? Anything that would block Jun 10 dry-run?

yuki-hw: Minor risk: image touch-up backlog; if delayed, we can use cropped screenshots instead.

raj-si: Risk: if staging quotas are low we cane28099t run parallel SI validations. Tom please prioritize quota for Jun 6-12.

deply-bot: (typo test) this message intentionally wrong

deploy-bot: Note: CI pipeline has a queued release for marketplace adapter. Please ensure version tag v1.2.3 is used for SI tests.

carla-comm: Action items recap: Ie28099ll prepare embargo note + press list by May 29. Blog first draft Jun 2. Social snippets by Jun 3.

lee-gTM: Ie28099ll publish SKU mapping and landing copy outline by May 28.

yuki-hw: Ie28099ll upload cleaned device photos and quickstart updates by Jun 1.

raj-si: Ie28099ll validate runbook and post full test commands by Jun 3.

marta-legal: Ie28099ll review partner quotes within 48h after receipt.

tom-ops: Provisioning and telemetry ready Jun 4. Quota bump requested for Jun 6-12.

jamie-partners: Nice. Ie28099ll finalize the playbook and share a single README with links to assets. Please mark items complete in the doc so we can close the gate. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Playbook doc created: https://docs.redwood/marketplace/playbooks/launch-gate-1849998888 (edit access granted to channel).
